Dominion and TENCORE plan Canadian TerMIT production for 2027

An MoU covers manufacturing transfer and AuraNet integration; definitive agreements remain to be completed.

Dominion Dynamics / PRNewswire ↗13 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

An initial memorandum

Ottawa-based Dominion Dynamics and Ukraine’s TENCORE signed an MoU to manufacture TerMIT uncrewed ground vehicles in Canada and integrate Dominion’s AuraNet. The AUSA 2026 signing in Washington targets initial production in 2027.

Manufacturing transfer and training

A TENCORE team will lead technology transfer and train Canadian technicians. TENCORE reports delivering more than 5,000 UGVs to Ukrainian units since 2024; that historical figure is not a new order or delivery commitment under this MoU.

Plans still require execution

The partners intend to add AuraNet onboard and pursue an Arctic-capable version. Definitive agreements remain outstanding, so the announcement does not establish an operating Canadian line, new delivery volumes or test results for the combined system.
